name: Filippina Iera
bioAdditions: Filippina was baptized on 6 March 1819, daughter of Rosario Iera and Faustina Ferlaino (S1). She married Raffaele Colosimo on 24 March 1839 (S2) and was buried on 10 November 1871 (S3). All three entries match the tree.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Baptism, marriage and burial indexed and consistent.
